name: docyt
description: Get financial reports, KPIs, transactions, and business insights from Docyt, right in your AI assistant.

interface.longDescription:
Ask about your business. Get answers from Docyt.

Connect Docyt to your AI assistant and get the financial information you need, simply by asking. No switching between apps or searching through reports.

What can you do?

• Explore your financials: Get profit and loss statements, balance sheets, and cash flow reports for any business or period.
• Track performance: Compare financial results across months or years and monitor key hospitality metrics like occupancy, ADR, and RevPAR.
• See the bigger picture: Get a consolidated view of performance across your businesses and properties.
• Find transactions: Check how much you paid a vendor or look up bank transactions.
• Stay on top of your accounting: Find missing bank statements and see how many transactions need review.

Your data stays under your control
Your assistant can only access the businesses, financial reports, KPIs, portfolio insights, and banking information available through your Docyt account. Your existing access permissions always apply.

What to know
The connector is read-only. You can explore and analyze your financial data, but actions like categorizing transactions, uploading documents, and completing month-end close still happen in Docyt.
Your answers reflect the latest data available in Docyt. If reports are refreshing or transactions are still under review, your assistant will let you know that the numbers may change.

Getting started
Simply sign in with your Docyt account and approve access. You can disconnect at any time through your assistant or Docyt settings.
Whether you manage one business, multiple properties, or accounting for several clients, just specify the business you want to explore or ask for a portfolio-wide view.

https://www.docyt.com/help/connect-ai-assistant/

positive.description: List the businesses the signed-in user can access
positive.prompt: Which businesses can I see in Docyt?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the businesses the reviewer account can access by name. The reviewer account has one business, Docyt ledger 3. No internal ids or handles are shown.

positive.prompt: How did my business do this year?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a year-to-date profit and loss summary for Docyt ledger 3 (revenue, expenses, net result). If the report is still refreshing, the answer says that the numbers may change.

positive.prompt: Show my business KPIs for this year.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the year-to-date KPI view for Docyt ledger 3, including gross revenue (about $8,000 YTD, from March 2026: $5,000 room revenue and $3,000 miscellaneous income), occupancy, ADR and RevPAR, and flags any KPI that is not available.

positive.prompt: How many transactions are pending review?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the count of bank transactions waiting for review for Docyt ledger 3, with the total and verified counts (about 122 pending of 128 total, 6 verified at recording time).

positive.prompt: Summarize the financial health of my business for this year.
positive.expected_behavior: Combines the year-to-date P&L, the KPI view and the transaction review status for Docyt ledger 3 into one short assessment, and states clearly when data is incomplete or not yet reconciled.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. It only reads financial data from the user's Docyt account.

publication.release_notes: Initial release. Read-only access to Docyt financial reports, business and portfolio KPIs, bank transactions and bank statement status.
